hooks.command: f=$(node -e 'let d="";process.stdin.on("data",c=>d+=c).on("end",()=>{try{const j=JSON.parse(d);process.stdout.write((j.tool_input&&j.tool_input.file_path)||(j.tool_response&&j.tool_response.filePath)||"")}catch(e){}})'); case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" 2>/dev/null || true; exec 9>/tmp/garden-tsc.lock; flock -n 9 || exit 0; out=$(npx tsc --noEmit --tsBuildInfoFile /tmp/garden-tsc.tsbuildinfo 2>&1 | grep "error TS" | head -20); [ -z "$out" ] && exit 0; printf "tsc --noEmit reported errors:\n%s\n" "$out"; exit 2

hit=$(node -e 'let d="";process.stdin.on("data",x=>d+=x).on("end",()=>{try{const c=(JSON.parse(d).tool_input||{}).command||"";if(/(^|[;&|]\s*)(npx\s+next\s+build|npm\s+run\s+build|yarn\s+(run\s+)?build|pnpm\s+(run\s+)?build)\b/.test(c))process.stdout.write("1")}catch(e){}})'); [ -n "$hit" ] || exit 0; pgrep -f "[n]ext (dev|start)" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; printf "%s" '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"A Next dev/start server is running and shares .next with the build, which throws a bogus PageNotFoundError. Stop it first (e.g. pkill -f concurrently), then rebuild."}}'
